maria-sales: Quick heads up — large healthcare POC (St. Atlas Health) wants a 12-month commit with tier-2 pricing and a 3-month free trial credit. Need deal-desk exception to apply discounted commit tiers beyond current ratecard. ACV ~ $180k, commit = $75k/mo for 12 months. Filing here: https://redwood.internal/sales/deals/SA-987
jason-dealdesk: Can you paste the proposed SKU/pricing line items? Need to check commit credit rules and margin impact.
maria-sales: Proposed lines:
```
- redwood-hosted-inference: 12m, committed 75k/mo -> discount 18% (vs list)
- dedicated-support: add-on 2 GPUs reserved
- DPA + SOC2 required; customer wants options for VPC
```
sophie-legal: Ping legal intake: we need SOW + counterparty contact before exceptions. Also will require security signoff for VPC work.
henry-ops: Heads up: dedicated capacity lead time ~6 weeks for GPU pool provisioning in us-east. Can we offer burst capacity until it's ready?
lina-secout: Security Qs: customer sent an initial infosec questionnaire asking about encryption at rest, SOC2, and KMS/HSM support. I'll upload answers to the questionnaire thread. If they want on-prem, that'll be a separate engage.
maria-sales: @jason-dealdesk tagging you — customer also asked for a one-time migration discount and grandfathering of pricing for 24 months after commit. We probably need a special term.
jason-dealdesk: Ok — routing to approvals. @approvals-bot please start exception review: org=Sales, deal=SA-987, ACV=180000, term=12m, request=commit-tier-exception + migration-credit
approvals-bot: Exception request created (ID EX-6842). Request requires: (1) Deal desk review, (2) Finance sign-off on margin impact, (3) Legal SOW & DPA confirmation, (4) Ops capacity plan. Link: https://redwood.internal/approvals/EX-6842 :white_check_mark:
maria-sales: Thanks — I'll attach the customer's questionnaire and the SOW draft. If finance needs another margin calc, ping me for the unit economics.
jason-dealdesk: Leaving an action item — I'll prep a short memo for the committee by EOD tomorrow. If anyone has risks (commit exposure, capacity tightness) drop them here. :eyes:
